pr_title: Improve safety for the multi-threaded executor using `UnsafeWorldCell`
pr_comments: Upon closer inspection, I noticed a couple more functions with undocumented invariants that had to be marked as `unsafe`. Also, I accidentally made `update_archetype_component_access` unsound, so I'm marking this PR as a draft until I resolve that.
I've resolved the issues I mentioned before.

> I usually prefer to write UnsafeWorldCell<'_> to make it clear that a fresh lifetime is involved, could you make that change here as well?

I can do that if you prefer it strongly, but IMO that's just an uglier way of writing the same thing. Being explicit about lifetimes only adds clarity if you're going to name them -- otherwise, elision is preferred. I don't think that `UnsafeWorldCell<'_>` carries any more information than `UnsafeWorldCell`.

Anyway, thank you for the review.
It's not a strong preference, we can keep it as is.

issue_context.title: Safety comments in `MultiThreadedExecutor` are incorrect
issue_context.body:
Both places where `System::run_unsafe` is called in `MultiThreadedExecutor` still have placeholder safety comments. They simply state that the safety invariants are upheld, without making any attempt to explain how they are upheld.
